marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:

then increasing to north 15 late Tuesday afternoon. Wind increasing to northwest

patches forming late this evening and dissipating late overnight. Visibility 1
mile or less in fog patches and in snow. Low tonight minus 9. High Tuesday minus 2. <br/>
